description: This is a Java test source file for the JMSMultiExternalEventProducer class. It contains unit tests validating the behavior of sending messages through multiple JMS producers, including load balancing based on hashing. The tests utilize Mockito for mocking dependencies and JUnit 5 for test execution.

classes.name: JMSMultiExternalEventProducerTest
classes.description: Test class for JMSMultiExternalEventProducer, testing message sending, load balancing, and interaction with JMS infrastructure.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mocks and the object under test before each test case.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Verifies that sessions are closed after each test.

methods.name: testSendEventsShouldWork
methods.description: Tests that a message is correctly sent to the producer for a given partition.

methods.name: testSendEventsBalancesBetweenProducers
methods.description: Tests that messages are balanced correctly across multiple producers based on hashing.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Creates a sample MessageV1 object, converts it to byte array for testing message sending.
